h1_capability_closure.evidence_note: Authored pre-parsed semantic frames; no language model or NLU was evaluated.

h2_dialogue_state.evidence_note: Authored state snapshots and deterministic outputs; no model memory extraction, retrieval ranking, or natural-language coreference was evaluated.

h3_proactive_contract.evidence_note: New authored valid cases plus rule-generated malformed mutations; no owner-preference or sensor-identity accuracy was measured.

h4_edge_cloud_router.evidence_note: Authored route labels and modelled list-price arithmetic. Local means deterministic/template response; reasoning assumes local TTS. It is not measured API spend, quality, network latency, or Orin throughput.

exclusions: transcription or separate TTS provider charges
local compute, energy, and Starlink charges
hosted realtime narration after the reasoning tier

local_policy_microbenchmark.evidence_note: Desktop CPython policy latency only; excludes ASR, semantic frame production, TTS, networking, model generation, and motion.
